connector.name: WhatsApp Web MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for WhatsApp via whatsapp-web.js: send/receive messages, media, chats, groups, contacts
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-whatsapp-web. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mario-andreschak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level for the log file (logs/mcp-whatsapp.log)

env.name: LOG_STDERR_LEVEL
env.description: Log level for stderr (visible in most MCP client logs)

env.name: WHATSAPP_HEADLESS
env.description: Set to false to show the browser window instead of running headless (debugging aid)

env.name: BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH
env.description: Browser executable. Chrome and Edge are auto-detected in their standard install locations; set this only to use a specific browser. A real Chrome/Edge is required for sending videos and GIFs.

env.name: WHATSAPP_SESSION_DIR
env.description: Where the WhatsApp session (browser profile) is stored (default: <working directory>/whatsapp-sessions)

env.name: WHATSAPP_PAIRING_PHONE_NUMBER
env.description: Phone number pairing: when set (international, symbol-free format, e.g. 4915112345678), an 8-character pairing code is logged to stderr on startup instead of relying on the QR code

env.name: FFMPEG_PATH
env.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)

env.name: WA_WEB_VERSION
env.description: Pin the WhatsApp Web version. Only set this if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client.

env.name: HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
env.description: Connection health check interval in milliseconds (<=0 disables)

env.name: TOOL_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: How long tool calls wait for the WhatsApp client to become ready before erroring

env.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
env.description: When set, additionally exposes the MCP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (Streamable HTTP) from the same process

env.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
env.description: Bind address for the HTTP endpoint (do not expose publicly; the endpoint controls your personal WhatsApp account)

env.name: MCP_OAUTH
env.description: Enable OAuth for the HTTP endpoint: /mcp requires a bearer token and clients authenticate via a browser page showing the WhatsApp QR code / pairing form
